title: Nazarbayev University Financial Aid and Scholarships for International Applicants — Foundation Year and Undergraduate programmes (2027–2028 cycle)
official_source: Nazarbayev University (NU), Office of the Registrar / International Admissions, Astana, Kazakhstan
duration: One-year Nazarbayev University Foundation Year Program (NUFYP) or a four-year undergraduate bachelor degree programme
description: Nazarbayev University's financial aid and scholarships route gives admitted Foundation Year and undergraduate applicants a second, separate competition for tuition coverage: applicants choose one of six published categories, must meet that category's minimum results, and submit the application in the Personal Account after receiving an admission offer.

title: Brunei Darussalam Government Scholarship for Foreign Students Tenable in Brunei Darussalam (BDGS)
official_source: Government of Brunei Darussalam, Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Ministry of Education
duration: Duration of the degree programme, up to a maximum of four years for undergraduate study and up to two years for postgraduate study under the standard BDGS terms

title: Mauritius-Africa Scholarship Scheme (MASS)

duration: Diploma up to three years, Bachelor's up to four years, MPhil up to two years plus six months for thesis defence, MPhil/PhD up to three years plus six months for the transfer report plus one year plus six months for the thesis defence, PhD up to three years plus six months

title: GETFund Postgraduate Local Scholarship (2026/27)
duration: Valid for the postgraduate programme duration as specified in the admission letter, subject to satisfactory academic performance; the admission letter must clearly state the programme duration. Sponsorship must be used for the academic year awarded - GETFund states that scholarships cannot be deferred.
description: The Ghana Education Trust Fund, a statutory Ghanaian education fund, has announced that applications for its 2026/27 Postgraduate Local Scholarship will open on Monday 5 October 2026 and close on Friday 27 November 2026. The scheme covers candidates pursuing Master's and PhD programmes within Ghana and is separate from the Fund's foreign scholarship programme. The Fund states that financial support to Scholars includes tuition fees, accommodation and scholastic materials. Applications are made only through the GETFund Scholarship Portal at scholarships.getfund.gov.gh.

title: International Excellence Scholarship 2027 (The University of Newcastle, Australia)
funding: Tuition Fee Waiver (20% of gross annual international tuition fee)
duration: Ongoing for each term of the eligible program, provided the conditions of the scholarship are maintained
description: The University of Newcastle's International Excellence Scholarship awards a tuition fee reduction equivalent to 20% of the gross annual international tuition fee to high-performing international students commencing a CRICOS-registered undergraduate or postgraduate coursework degree in 2027 or later. No application is required: eligibility is assessed automatically when the student applies for admission, and the value is notified in the Letter of Offer. The University states the indicative number available as 500.

title: Beca Posgrado STEM Regional (Fulbright-Garcia Robles) - COMEXUS
official_source: U.S.-Mexico Commission for Educational and Cultural Exchange (COMEXUS), the Fulbright Commission in Mexico
program_type: Bilateral government exchange scholarship (United States-Mexico commission)
duration: Master's: up to 18 months. Doctorate: up to three years.
description: The Beca Posgrado STEM Regional is a Fulbright-Garcia Robles postgraduate scholarship run by COMEXUS, the U.S.-Mexico Commission for Educational and Cultural Exchange, for Mexican nationals who originate from and live in the interior of Mexico outside Mexico City, Guadalajara, Monterrey and their metropolitan areas. It funds a master's or doctorate in science, technology, engineering and mathematics at a US university for students starting in August 2028, with up to USD 37,000 per academic year for master's study lasting up to 18 months and up to USD 25,000 per academic year for doctoral study

title: Becas Nacionales de Inclusión 2026 (A. Becas de Licenciatura para Jefas de Familia; B. Apoyos Complementarios para Personas Indígenas; C. Apoyos Complementarios para Personas con Discapacidad)
official_source: Secretaría de Ciencia, Humanidades y Tecnología (SECIHTI), Gobierno de México
duration: One academic cycle per award; renewal is handled through the SECIHTIbecas programme manuals (Trámite de Conclusión de la Beca / Proceso de Renovación), which are published as PDFs on the convocatoria page and were not read.
description: The SECIHTI Becas Nacionales de Inclusion 2026 convocatoria groups three tracks: bachelor's scholarships for Mexican women who head their families (Track A), and complementary supports for Mexican indigenous people (Track B) and Mexican people with disabilities (Track C) who already hold a SECIHTI national postgraduate scholarship, each governed by its published Terminos de Referencia.
